pages.title: India–EU Free Trade Agreement concluded

facts.text: India and EU concluded negotiations on a comprehensive FTA — ⚠ EU is India's 22nd FTA partner

facts.text: Next: legal scrubbing, translation, ratification by 27 member states and European Parliament
facts.head: News

facts.text: Item: Tariff lines liberalised; EU: 97%; India: 92.1%
facts.head: Commitments

facts.text: Item: Share of partner's exports covered; EU: 99.5% of Indian exports; India: 97.5% of EU exports
facts.head: Commitments

facts.text: Item: Services subsectors; EU: 144; India: 102
facts.head: Commitments

facts.text: Labour-intensive gains: textiles, apparel, leather, footwear, marine, gems & jewellery, toys, sports goods — current tariffs 4–26%; ~USD 33 billion exports become duty-free

facts.text: IPR: TRIPS compliance; safeguards for generics, TKDL

facts.text: India avg tariff 10–12% vs EU 3–4%
